The main takeaway from our work is that
, for a fixed number of clusters, the maximum throughput of the network is not necessarily obtained by having each node communicate with a single cluster head.
, in clustered networks, the scaling exponent of the capacity is not necessarily equal to the scaling exponent of connectivity.
, in clustered ad hoc networks, the optimal communication strategy is not the one that would be chosen for a homogeneous Poisson point process, as it is usually done in the literature.
